subject: ov.names method of finding number of groups

messages.author: d9ced0277ffec420
messages.subject: ov.names method of finding number of groups
parts:
HI all.

I recently came across an error I have not encountered before. The same model worked fine in version 05.12, but does not work in 05.14 (or 05.15). It is a multi-group model, specified the non-traditional way, and minimum working example of my syntax is:

a.cov <- c(7,1,2,2,1,5,8,4,6,36)
a.cov <- getCov(a.cov, names=c("W", "X", "Y", "Z"))


b.cov <- c(13,2,3,5,2,10,11,4,9,25)
b.cov <- getCov(b.cov, names=c("W", "X", "Y", "Z"))

comb.cov <- list(grp.a=a.cov, grp.b=b.cov)

model <- '
grp.a:
LV =~ W + l*X + Y + Z

grp.b:
LV =~ W + l*X + Y + Z
'

fit <- cfa(model, sample.cov=comb.cov, sample.n=c(100,100))

The error message I get when executing the cfa() function is

Error in lavData(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: ov.names assumes 3 groups; data contains 2 groups

Any ideas why ov.names is picking up an extra group in the model specification?


BTW, the it works fine specifying the model the traditional way:

modelR <- '
LV =~ W + c(l,l)*X + Y + Z
'
fitR <- cfa(modelR, sample.cov=comb.cov, sample.n=c(100,100))


Thanks,

Alex
